weaknesses: Abstract inaccurately describes the contributions, focusing on CRISPR instead of Lipschitz continuity.
Claims in the abstract about the implications of Lipschitz continuity are overstated and not sufficiently supported by results.
The paper lacks a comprehensive discussion on the limitations of the proposed methods and findings.
The experimental setup does not include sufficient baseline comparisons to validate the claims made about Lipschitz behavior.
strengths: The paper provides a novel perspective on Lipschitz continuity in neural networks, exploring its implications in various contexts.
Empirical results are presented across a range of models and datasets, demonstrating the robustness of the findings.
The exploration of the relationship between Lipschitz continuity and over-parameterization is insightful and contributes to the understanding of neural network behavior.
